reviews.title: Exceptional Customer Care Despite the Outcome
reviews.text:
I don't normally write long reviews, but Vio genuinely earned this one.

I recently booked a stay through Vio that ended up becoming much more complicated than I ever expected due to personal circumstances. Throughout the entire experience, the customer support team consistently treated me with kindness, patience, and professionalism.

Early on, one representative went above and beyond by helping coordinate with the hotel so I could remain in the same room instead of having to switch rooms between reservations. That alone made a stressful situation significantly easier.

Later, I had the pleasure of working with Selsebil, Halima, and Netrojit. Each of them took the time to listen to my concerns, explain every available option, and genuinely tried to help. At no point did I ever feel like I was receiving copy-and-paste responses. They communicated like real people who cared about providing excellent service.

Although my request for a partial refund was ultimately denied by the hotel, that's not something I blame Vio for. In fact, what impressed me most was how hard their team advocated for me behind the scenes. Netrojit personally explained that he presented my case, followed up multiple times with the hotel, and exhausted every reasonable avenue before delivering the unfortunate news. Even then, he offered another possible path by encouraging me to contact the hotel directly.

Customer service isn't measured only by the outcome. It's measured by the effort, communication, honesty, and willingness to help. In every one of those areas, Vio exceeded my expectations.

Thank you to everyone who assisted me, especially Halima, Selsebil, Netrojit, and the representative who first helped me keep the same room. You all turned what could have been a frustrating experience into one where I genuinely felt supported.

I'll absolutely consider booking through Vio again in the future.
